message: Astra: Within “Core Algorithm Optimization,” you drafted a room with laptops but preferred attention to task assignments; what does that room let a reader understand that the dialogue alone does not? Which detail, if any, deserves further attention given your priority? Why would more thinking about its role be worth the time compared with trying a revision now, and what unresolved uncertainty might make thinking first more valuable? What evidence on the page would justify your choice, and what next step will you choose and carry out?
